$ pllm --help
usage: pllm [-h] [--format {human,json,jsonl}] [--quiet] [--no-color]
            [--no-input] [--dry-run] [--version]
            COMMAND ...

Inspect PLLM configuration, run benchmarks, and inspect research metadata

positional arguments:
  COMMAND
    config              inspect or export public configuration
    components          inspect built-in component descriptors
    research            inspect or assess read-only research records
    benchmark           run reproducible local benchmarks
    dev                 development tools

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {human,json,jsonl}
                        result format (default: human)
  --quiet               suppress non-error diagnostics
  --no-color            disable colored output
  --no-input            fail instead of prompting
  --dry-run             report work without persistent writes or service
                        startup
  --version             show program's version number and exit

$ pllm benchmark run --help
usage: pllm benchmark run [-h] [--format {human,json,jsonl}] [--quiet]
                          [--no-color] [--no-input] [--dry-run]
                          [--model MODEL] [--model-id MODEL_ID] [--tiny]
                          [--prompt PROMPT | --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE]
                          [--max-output-tokens MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS]
                          [--warmups WARMUPS] [--repetitions REPETITIONS]
                          [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--show-dashboard]
                          [--output OUTPUT] [--force]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {human,json,jsonl}
                        result format (default: human)
  --quiet               suppress non-error diagnostics
  --no-color            disable colored output
  --no-input            fail instead of prompting
  --dry-run             report work without persistent writes or service
                        startup
  --model MODEL         Hugging Face model ID or local checkpoint path
  --model-id MODEL_ID   stable model identity stored in the report
  --tiny                use generated random weights for a transport smoke
                        test
  --prompt PROMPT       prompt text (visible in shell process listings)
  --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE
                        read prompt text from this file
  --max-output-tokens MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
                        maximum generated tokens per run (default: 24)
  --warmups WARMUPS     warmup runs retained in the report (default: 0)
  --repetitions REPETITIONS
                        measured runs (default: 1)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     startup and per-run timeout in seconds (default: 900)
  --show-dashboard      open the local dashboard in a browser (default:
                        hidden)
  --output OUTPUT       write the sanitized JSON report
  --force               replace --output if it exists
